heading: Police Hiring Round Draws 46 Applicants
category: Sun Prairie Police and Fire Commission
summary: Police staff reported 46 applications during a two-week recruitment window. Thirty-four applicants attended interviews, and staff said the goal was to fill four positions. The commission took up certification of the October eligibility list after a closed session.

heading: Wisconsin Opposes Proposed Changes to Head Start Standards
summary: Wisconsin DOJ joined a multistate comment letter opposing proposed changes to federal Head Start rules. The coalition raised concerns about reducing requirements for the early childhood program. The filing responds to a proposal from the Department of Health and Human Services.
